notes: Every endpoint class implements IEndpointGroup; WebApplicationExtensions.MapEndpoints finds them by reflection and mounts each on app.MapGroup($"/api/{type.Name}"), and the routes use the project's own wrapper groupBuilder.MapPost(handler, "pattern") (handler first, pattern optional). Nothing is extracted and nothing is wrong (route-by-name-convention / custom-map-wrapper): a convention (route_patterns, ADR-003) is the place for it, not the extractor. MapIdentityApi<ApplicationUser>() adds the ASP.NET Identity routes under /api/Users — framework-generated, not listed.
